sources.label: Morphe patches for reddit apps
sources.author: Patcheddit
patch_list: Disable ads
Fix broken markdown links
Repairs malformed user and subreddit links while preserving code and ordinary links.
Fix comment video links
Restores native playback of Reddit videos embedded in comments.
Fix escaped URLs
Fixes URLs broken by backslash-escaped punctuation in Reddit posts and comments.
Fix Redgifs API
Fetches a fresh Redgifs API token so Redgifs videos load.
Fix swipe back transparency
Shows the previous screen while swiping back on newer Android versions.
Joey Morphe settings
Adds a Morphe settings menu for included patches, with exception and fatal crash log viewers.
Log exceptions
Logs reported errors and fatal crashes, viewable in Morphe settings.
Reddit API fixes
Restores Reddit API access and login with the fixes required by this app.
Spoof client
Restores saved OAuth options from before 2.3.0. Includes Reddit API fixes. Launch the updated app once to save these values in its API settings before deselecting this patch.

sources.label: Mighty Morphing Joey patches!
sources.author: Mighty Morphing
patch_list: Arctic Shift restore

[v1.4.5: Link preview fix.] Removed and deleted comments, and removed posts on the comments screen, get an Arctic Shift Restore button that brings back the archived text. Nothing is fetched until you tap it. Works with Modern UI or Classic…
Backup and restore

Save Joey and Morphe settings to a file and restore them later, including splash, theme, fonts, comments, and show and hide. Log in to the same Reddit account before restoring subscriptions. Access via Joey Settings - Morphe Settings.
Disable tooltips
Turns off the first-run tips Joey shows.
Dismiss without tearing
Swiping a photo away to close it looks smooth instead of tearing.
Editor image and GIF upload

Uploads images and GIFs to Reddit directly when adding comments. Both can be uploaded via the image button. Also adds keyboard gif auto upload to reddit (click markdown in editor (far left icon) to enable keyboard gif support).
Fix collapsed replies
Loads replies that stay hidden when Reddit will not open them. Based on the Patcheddit fix.
Fix login page
Makes Reddit's login page load and work properly inside Joey, and clears the cookie banner out of the way.
Inline comment media

Shows GIFs, pictures, subreddit emojis and Reddit videos in comments instead of links. Tap to open, drag left or right to resize, and scroll past them as normal. YouTube links use a 16:9 preview with the title. Extra settings in Joey Setti…
Log in with your own client ID

Lets Joey log in with another app's client ID, for when Joey's own login stops working. Normal option here is to sign in to RedReader once, then paste the App ID from Reddit's "you authorized an app" email into this patch's settings in exp…
Media enhancements

[v1.5.0: New. The Modern UI media features, now as their own patch so Classic Joey can have them too. Nothing changes for existing users; Modern UI already includes all of this.] Downloads with your own file names and folder, full screen m…
Modern UI

[v1.5.0: The media features (downloads, full screen media, album viewer and more) are now shared with the new Media enhancements patch, so Classic Joey users can have them too. Nothing changes for existing users. Media options now have the…
Open Reddit share links

Opens modern Reddit share links directly to the right post or comment in Joey instead of loading the web page. To open Reddit links from other apps, make sure all links are ticked in Android Settings -> Apps -> Joey -> Open by default.
RedGifs with sound
RedGifs clips play with their sound, in HD when it's available.
Search auto open keyboard
Opens the keyboard automatically for homepage search and comment search. The Enter and Search keys start the search.
Seasonal sidebar banner
Shows a picture in the sidebar header that changes with the season, or one you choose. If you set it back to Joey's image, any picture Joey had already saved is still there and gets used again.
Show/Hide

Choose which comment editor buttons, sidebar entries, subreddit toolbar items and post actions are shown, and drag to reorder them. What doesn't fit on a post goes in its menu. Adjust in Joey Settings - Morphe Settings.
Skip ads and checks
Removes ads everywhere and also drops the Play Store install check and crash reporting.
Splash Screen

[v1.4.0: Match theme keeps your chosen animation.] Logo inspired by u/otheast. Logo, colours and animation can be customised, follow your theme, or the animation can be turned off, in Joey Settings - Morphe Settings.
Subreddit filter options
Adds a subreddit suffix filter and lets you toggle subreddit filters on or off without deleting them. Configure in Joey - Settings - Filters, or from the feed Filter out posts menu.
